==Description==
'''UI-60''' is the 4th entity you may encounter within [[Section Interchange]], more info below.

== Behavior ==
When '''UI-60''' spawns, it will play the composition known as "Horror Race", like all the other entities that reside within the I-Section. If there are more entities present, it will play the same song but with a higher pitch and speed.

It will appear very far away from the main room. It will rush quickly to the main room despawning as soon as it touches the door.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* If not already, hide when you hear his laughter.

== Trivia ==
* Like most UI entities, '''UI-60''' was added as a joke.
